# Afsnit 340: En overraskende udvikling (NVIDIA, Nike, Novo)

**Feed**: investeringspodcasten  
**Published**: 2026-09-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish investing podcast (Hansen & Larsen, ep. 340). It covers Nike's five-year collapse of about 75% ahead of its Q1 FY27 report, Nvidia's falling valuation (around 14-15x 2027 earnings) despite roughly 100% revenue growth and a USD 150bn buyback, and a weak September for Danish and German indices. Novo Nordisk and DSV are singled out as the 'lights gone out' in Denmark: Novo has lost touch with the market and investors want a large acquisition, while DSV suffers from investor distrust even though analysts are puzzled by the sell-off. The episode is mostly cautious, with modestly positive structural views on Nvidia and DSV and no explicit buy/sell calls.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Multiple compressed to ~14-15x 2027 EPS despite ~100% growth; USD 150bn buyback; host sees no warning sign and strong multi-year demand.

#### Reasoning

The co-host says he does not see the falling valuation as a warning sign from a business standpoint, because demand for Nvidia's products stays high for many years. He accepts that growth rates may slow as the company gets bigger and that capital may rotate elsewhere in the AI value chain. The record buyback supports shareholder returns.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth rates fall sharply
- if AI capital spending shifts away from chipmakers
- if market leadership is lost

> *"Altså, virksomhedsmæssigt, så ser jeg ikke umiddelbart i tilfælde med Nvidia, som et advarselssignal."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lost market trust; catalysts are a large acquisition and pipeline readouts for CagriSema and amycretin.

#### Reasoning

The hosts argue Novo has lost its connection to the stock market, so new announcements do not change earnings expectations. Investors want a ~USD 10bn acquisition of a late-stage asset to address the 2031-32 patent cliff. Trust can only come back through consistent delivery over time. The hosts will keep monitoring CagriSema and amycretin.

#### Sell Triggers

- if there is no replacement for semaglutide before the patent cliff
- if CagriSema or amycretin data disappoint
- if no major acquisition materialises

> *"Vi må holde øje med calcrisema, amikritin, som kommer i piller og i en injektionsform."*

---

### 🟠 DSV — DSV | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down from ~1900 to ~1200 while 2027 earnings expectations barely changed; analyst targets around 1900-2000.

#### Reasoning

The hosts suggest the stock has become cheaper because earnings expectations have held while the price fell on distrust and a rising risk premium. Cited analysts (a large recognised house trimmed its target from 2000 to 1900) cannot understand the decline. The problems sit in road, which is about one fifth of revenue. Foreign sellers drive the swings, so no explicit buy call was made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if 2027 earnings estimates are cut materially
- if integration synergies fail to materialise

> *"Det er jo ikke sådan, at kursmålene ligger meget lavere."*

---

### 🟠 NKE — Nike | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Q1 FY27 report is a test of whether Nike can signal a bottom; the host explicitly says this is not a recommendation.

#### Reasoning

Nike has lost touch with consumers, lost market share and is under pressure in China and from nimbler brands. The upcoming report will show whether CEO Elliott Hill can signal a bottom. Sentiment is negative overall, but no explicit sell call was made.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q1 FY27 report shows continued revenue decline
- if China sales keep falling

> *"er så rap på fodskiftet, at de kan signalere, er bunden af noget."*

---
